notes: Nintendo 3DS firmware/CIA fetch (Windows): under Settings → Nintendo 3DS, link the Google Drive folder that holds your 3DS firmware / CIA files, then tap 'Fetch 3DS files from Drive' to download every CIA into Documents\PokeTracker\3DS. Install them into your 3DS emulator afterward (Azahar: File → Install CIA → select all), and 'Open 3DS folder' jumps right to them. Like the DS BIOS, these copyrighted files stay in your private Drive and are never bundled into the app.
